items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know them, though, when I was at Tuxedo.

ctx.x: So, it was a lot of fun. So, we started playing out there in the afternoon and I think we quit about 7:00 at night, 8:00 cause there wasn't nothing out there at night. Then, we'd go back to Tuxedo Junction which is a couple of blocks to get on the streetcar. And, we'd ride back to the city. You know, it's a suburb right in the city, which was the subway to Birmingham.
Well, let me see, like Willie Mays, a few others, you know, all of them stayed out there. I'm trying to figure out who else I could call. I didn't know them, though, when I was at Tuxedo.
The way it is right now, you wouldn't know it. All they have there now is the big plaque at the building. But, everything is changed like other cities. But, it's beautiful, though.
